data.name: Background Image
data.help: Desktop background image URL. Leave empty to show no image. Supports direct image URLs and random-image APIs.

data.name: Mobile Background Image
data.help: Separate mobile background image URL. Leave empty to use the desktop setting.

data.name: Site Logo
data.help: Logo image URL. Leave empty to use the site icon configured in Komari. Custom images fall back to the site icon if they fail to load.

data.name: Custom Illustration
data.help: Illustration URL for the right side of the overview. Leave empty to use the default.

data.name: Theme Mode
data.help: Force a theme mode. Choose the system setting to allow visitors to switch modes.

data.name: Custom Links
data.help: JSON array of links shown in the top navigation, for example: [{"link":"https://example.com","name":"Example"}].

data.name: Show Service Monitoring
data.help: Show the ServiceTracker panel with 30-day availability on the overview.

data.name: Show World Map
data.help: Show a map of server locations on the overview.

data.name: Compact Server Cards
data.help: Show server cards in a compact inline layout.

data.name: Group Display Order
data.help: Set group order. All stays first. Use comma- or newline-separated names or a JSON array, for example Hong Kong,Japan,United States. Other groups follow in name order.

data.name: Hide Animated Illustration
data.help: Hide the animated illustration on the overview. Enabled by default.

data.name: Hide Overview Illustration
data.help: Hide the decorative hand icon beside the overview title. Enabled by default.

data.name: Use SVG Flags
data.help: Use SVG flags instead of emoji flags for more consistent rendering.

data.name: Show Traffic Progress Bar
data.help: Show traffic usage on server cards when a traffic quota is configured.

data.name: Show Visitor Badge
data.help: Briefly display visitor IP, region, and carrier at the bottom of the page.

data.name: Visitor Badge Color
data.help: Accent color for the visitor badge, adapted to light and dark modes.

data.name: Show Assets Card
data.help: Show the assets summary in the upper right. Amounts use the configured default and per-server currencies.

data.name: Assets Card Color
data.help: Accent color for the assets card, adapted to light and dark modes.

data.name: Assets Card Currency
data.help: Default display currency for the assets summary. Visitors can temporarily change it on the card.

data.name: Clip Network Chart Spikes
data.help: Clip anomalous peaks in network traffic charts to improve readability.

data.name: Pin Server Name on Left
data.help: Pin server names to the left of cards and show resources on the right. Takes precedence over pinning names at the top.

data.name: Pin Server Name at Top
data.help: Pin server names to the top of cards and show resources below.

data.name: Hide Remaining-Time Bar
data.help: Hide the time bar below remaining days on server cards. Enabled by default.

data.name: Show Upload and Download Totals
data.help: Show total uploaded and downloaded traffic at the bottom of server cards.

data.name: Hide IPv4/IPv6 Labels
data.help: Hide the IPv4 and IPv6 labels normally shown on server cards.

data.name: Hide Traffic Label
data.help: Hide the traffic label on server cards.

data.name: Default Billing Currency
data.help: Currency used when no override applies. The backend setting reads the node currency field; bare yen symbols are interpreted as CNY. Use JPY or JP¥ for Japanese yen.

data.name: CNY Symbol Style
data.help: Prefix for CNY amounts. The yen symbol is compact when most nodes use CNY; Japanese yen then gains a JPY label. Use CNY text when most nodes use JPY.

data.name: Server Currency Overrides
data.help: JSON object mapping server UUID, card ID, or name to a currency, such as {"Tokyo":"JPY","spartanhost":"USD"}. Prefer currency tags such as <JPY>, <USD>, or <CNY> on Komari nodes; they are hidden in the public UI. Precedence: this JSON, tags, default currency, then backend currency.

data.name: Show Latency on Overview
data.help: Show recent one-hour latency, packet loss, and trends on overview cards. Create a latency task in the admin UI first. Disabling this also stops related queries.

data.name: Show Percentage
data.help: Show used percentage at the upper right of the traffic progress bar.

data.name: Show Traffic Reset Day
data.help: Show calendar days until the next traffic reset. Recent Komari versions sync node settings automatically.

data.name: Show Billing Mode
data.help: Show the billing mode, such as bidirectional or one-way, on the progress bar.

data.name: Traffic Reset Day Overrides
data.help: The server reset day syncs automatically when available. For older versions, use a <TRD:1> node tag or a JSON override by UUID, card ID, or name. Precedence: server field, tags, this setting; otherwise N/A.
